Intro

Hi, I’m Prarthana Panikar.

A third-year Computer Science Engineering student passionate about exploring the intersection of technology, algorithms and intelligent systems.

I enjoy turning ideas into practical applications through hands-on development, experimentation and problem-solving. My journey spans Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Full-Stack Development, Blockchain, Computer Vision, IoT and Digital Systems.

From AI-powered traffic surveillance and intelligent mobility platforms to blockchain applications and algorithmic solutions, I keep exploring how computer science can address real-world challenges.

I’m particularly interested in strengthening my theoretical foundations, developing research-oriented thinking and exploring emerging technologies through advanced academic learning.
